MINUTES
  SPECIAL MEETING: GLENDALE CITY COUNCIL
  RICK REYES COMMUNITY ROOM AT THE GLENDALE POLICE STATION
  131 N. Isabel St., Glendale, CA 91206
  OCTOBER 1, 2024

The Special Public Meeting of the Glendale City Council convened in the Police Community
Room, in said City, at 11:00 a.m., on the above date, pursuant to a call for such meeting signed
by the City Clerk of the City Council, and on file with the City Clerk, a copy of which is as follows:

  September 26, 2024
  Date

  A SPECIAL PUBLIC MEETING of the City Council is hereby called to meet at 11:00 AM
on Tuesday, October 1, 2024, in the Rick Reyes Police Community Room, 131 N. Isabel St.,
Glendale, CA 91206 to consider the following item(s) of business, to wit;

1. GOOD GOVERNANCE WORKSHOP
  a. Common myths about government
  b. Government roles and rules simplified
  c. Decision making what data matters
  d. Steps to building consensus on decisions

Written Notice of said meeting was given, which Notice consisted of a copy of the
foregoing Call, and was served on each Member of the Council not joining in the Call, and
upon the in said City not less than 24 hours before the time fixed in said Call for said
meeting, as follows:
  Upon Dan Brotman  at 5:00 p.m.  September 26, 2024 Glendale, CA
  Upon Vartan Gharpetian  at 5:00 p.m.  September 26, 2024 Glendale, CA
  Upon Ardy Kassakhian  at 5:00 p.m.  September 26, 2024 Glendale, CA
  Upon Ara Najarian  at 5:00 p.m.  September 26, 2024 Glendale, CA
  Upon Elen Asatryan  at 5:00 p.m.  September 26, 2024 Glendale, CA
Mayor Asatryan called the meeting to order at 11:00 a.m.

ROLL CALL
  - All Present
  - Report of the City Clerk of the City Council, re: Posting of Agenda. The Agenda for the
  Tuesday, October 1, 2024, Special Public Meeting of the City Council was posted on
  September 26, 2024, on the Bulletin Board Outside City Hall.

The City of Glendale, California, held a City Council Governance Workshop on October 1, 2024,
from 11:00 AM to 3:00 PM, at the Police Community Room.

The Council workshop was planned and facilitated by Kevin Lyons, with logistical support
provided by City staff.

Kevin Lyons gave a presentation, facilitated a discussion and fielded questions from City
Council on Good Governance including:

1. GOOD GOVERNANCE WORKSHOP
  a. Common myths about government
  b. Government roles and rules simplified
  c. Decision making what data matters
  d. Steps to building consensus on decisions

Council recessed at 12:26 p.m. and reconvened at 1:07 p.m.

Public Comments:
Herbert Molano
Allan Durham

  1
 ADJOURNMENT – 2:26 p.m.
  Moved:  Kassakhian  Seconded:  Brotman

  Mayor of the City of Glendale
